contract: Bind the type qualifier once with scope/shadow/ambiguity rules.
Normalize the complete parent application before resolving a member.
Constructor arguments come from the normalized parent environment, including reordered, omitted, injected and constant operands.
Keep source alias arguments for alias arity/domain validation; do not bind them a second time against the underlying enum header.
Bare concrete aliases provide their underlying application even without written type arguments.
Checked member and call facts survive dependency-page replacement.

remaining_reproductions.status: All three initial local alias member regressions now pass; expanded symbolic, constant, 32 injected operand, invalid header/context, and workspace checks pass.

rejected_reader_experiment.reason: Adding checked parent graph traversal inside shared explicit environment readers stalls GPU-driver creation of calls/03k_project_argument_contexts. A 60-second whole-compiler timeout and two 45-second isolated pipeline timeouts reproduce it. Removing unused reflected resources and replacing a linear domain-slot selector with five fixed partitions did not resolve it.
rejected_reader_experiment.rollback: Experimental readers and binding changes restored to before-images; stable parent resolution remains.

next_implementation.boundary: Publish complete immutable explicit binding rows once after header/parent binding and before inference reads them.
next_implementation.descriptor: Per applying token: start-plus-one, reserved row capacity, type-slot mask, constant-slot mask. Source and normalized parent forms produce the same relation.
next_implementation.rows: Checked tag/payload pairs ordered by type slot, then constant slot. Lookup uses mask membership and countbits of lower bits; it traverses neither source HIR nor the type graph.
next_implementation.capacity: Use a bounded compact row arena, provisionally eight binding rows per source-token capacity. Reserve once per call/application and reuse that range on later inference rounds; exact sizing and exhaustion diagnostic must be reviewed against existing allocator patterns.
next_implementation.producer: Keep source-header slot/constant-role validation. Imported header mappings are retained while their page is resident. Materialize source bindings only after checked type refs exist. Alias constructor operands come from the normalized parent, including injected/reordered/constant operands.
next_implementation.consumers: Shared explicit environment readers and final explicit validation consume descriptor masks/rows; native accepted context snapshot stays on its existing contract.
next_implementation.bare_concrete_alias: An alias with no written arguments still supplies its concrete parent. Bare and called units consume that complete normalized parent. Do not confuse an unbound declaration template with an applied parent.
next_implementation.gates: New focused alias member/negative controls, existing own-header/method/constant/qualified enum controls, workspace reset/reuse, graph resource checks, cold pipeline preparation, then relevant performance.

flat_binding_implementation.producer: Extend the existing 03a0 binder after normalized type availability, including imported mappings already retained by dependency projection. Its initial and method-inference dispatches already precede readers. No extra producer dispatch is needed.
flat_binding_implementation.storage: Descriptor (start+1, reserved capacity, type mask, constant mask) per source token; 8 tag/payload rows per token plus one counter, reset per job by 01_resolve. Reserve only after complete references exist, reuse on inference rounds, reject exhausted storage.
flat_binding_implementation.reader: One mask/rank lookup. Source HIR and parent graph decoding stay inside the producer.
flat_binding_implementation.sequence: First flatten the existing source bindings with control tests, then add normalized parent publication and validate all descriptor slots.
flat_binding_implementation.body_replay: Type and payload columns participate in existing accepted-type specialization. Constant operand tags retain a distinct high-bit domain. The constant type-graph replay pass now handles generated nominal arguments as well as array lengths.
flat_binding_implementation.initialization: Descriptor and counter reset per job. Clear the complete tag capacity so replay can safely scan it after a larger reused workspace job; unpublished payloads are never read.

current_status: 36 selected checks pass: 34 runtime/rejection integration checks and both graph resource/lowering contracts. Imported generic alias substitution remains open.
